factorial_decomposition.definition: T = CIE 2deg linear catch (Arm A direction); CN = Naka-Rushton(half_sat 512, adaptation 0) applied to CIE catch in eye-quanta units; GL = eye Gaussian catch, linear, expected quanta; EY = real eye output. Angles in deg between (RG,BY) 2-vectors. energy_peak: CIE catch = QUANTA_SCALE*ArmA LMS; quantal_peak: per-quantum CIE sensitivity renormalised to peak 1 per cone.

zero_crossings_440_600nm.note: L and M share half_sat 512 and adaptation 0, so NR cannot move the RG zero; any RG-zero shift is sensitivity.

metamers_attribution.note: CIE+NR keeps CIE metamers (per-cone monotone map of identical catches); the Gaussian-linear catch already breaks them, so breaking is a sensitivity effect.
